audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1 and 2 are given to Urgot or scored as even, while the page's own early text says Jayce out-ranges everything you have until level 3.
audit.why: The mirror re-set the sides to Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, and on rows 0 and 1 that agrees with this page's spikes[0] and early text: gate-empowered Shock Blast simply out-ranges a champion whose damage starts at 490. Those two rows are flipped as matched pairs. Rows 2 and 6 are NOT changed: the mirror wants Skill at level 3 and Urgot at 2+ items, but this packet and every piece of prose on the page say Urgot at level 3 and a late game that swings back to Jayce — that disagreement is escalated rather than guessed.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 set to Jayce in both layers with ratings rescaled; rows 2 and 6 left alone pending the question below.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast is the tracked ability on every line and never carries a cooldown, and the gate interaction is never spelled out as a tell.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s, Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s at 240, Lightning Field 10s, the stance swap 6s. Fired through the Acceleration Gate the blast gains missile speed, range and damage — so the gate going down first is the warning, not the cast. Yours: Purge 12/9/6/3/0s inside 490, Disdain 16s at rank 1, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the gate tell now sit in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Echoing Flames with shields in three places, and never mentions that his stance swap is an auto reset whose first hit reduces armour and magic resist.
audit.why: Echoing Flames is 'blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage' — no shield anywhere in the text. The shield is on Disdain, which is also what makes the melee commit survivable. On his side, the Mercury Cannon/Hammer swap is a 6s auto reset and the first attack after it shreds resistances, so the swap animation is the cue to step back and the reason armour stacking is not a complete answer.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[2] and mid now put the shield on Disdain; report[5].t states the swap reset and the resistance shred.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: E or W second by kill pressure, but your damage starts at 490 and his does not — take the poke behind minions and wait for 3.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Jayce To the Skies! / Shock Blast: Hammer: leap + slow. Cannon: a long-range artillery line. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Shock Blast: 16/14/12/10/8/6s. Fired through his Acceleration Gate it gains speed, range and damage — the gate landing first is your tell. - Thundering Blow: 20s at rank 1, and it knocks you straight back out of Purge range.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1. Watch the gate — fired through it, the blast is faster.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — W-shred him.
edits.after: The stance swap resets his auto and that hit shreds your armour — step back on the swap.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — Jayce's range pokes but has no way to commit a kill yet.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Shock Blast out-ranges everything you own at 490.

edits.before: Level 2 stays a skill check as both trade with one extra ability and no all-in.
edits.after: Level 2 stays his: gate-empowered Shock Blast pokes and you cannot answer.

edits.before: Jayce's ranged Shock Blast (Q) through Acceleration Gate out-ranges everything you have, so levels 1-2 are a skill test of dodging poke behind minions. From level 3, once you can layer Corrosive Charge (Q), Purge (W) and Disdain (E), you close the gap: walk him down with your E, empower an auto off Echoing Flames (P) shields, and force melee-range trades where you win.
edits.after: Jayce's Shock Blast (Q) through the Acceleration Gate out-ranges everything you have, so levels 1-2 are a test of dodging poke behind minions. From level 3, once you can layer Corrosive Charge (Q), Purge (W) and Disdain (E), you close: Disdain shields you as it charges, and inside 490 Purge prioritises whoever you just tagged, so melee is where you win.

edits.before: After your first item you win any sustained fight — Jayce is a glass poke champion with no resistances, so your W shreds him and a single R flip ends him. Keep the wave near your side so his Gate combo has less room and force him to melee-trade into your P shields.
edits.after: After your first item you win any sustained fight — Jayce buys almost no resistances, so Purge grinds him down and Black Cleaver compounds it. Keep the wave near your side so his gate combo has less room, and make him trade at 490 where Disdain's shield covers your commit.

edits.before: From level 3 onward you take over — layering Q slow, W shred and E to walk him down forces melee trades where his lack of resistances and your Echoing Flames shields win, and level 6 R gives you a hard kill he can't dash out of.
edits.after: From level 3 onward you take over — layering Corrosive Charge's slow, Purge and Disdain walks him into melee, where his lack of resistances loses the grind and Disdain's shield covers your entry, and level 6 gives you a finish on anyone already low.

notes: Partial chart change on purpose: rows 0 and 1 flipped to Jayce because the mirror and this page's own early text agree, but the mirror also wants Skill at level 3 and Urgot at 2+ items, which contradicts both this packet chart and the page's whys[6]/late/spikes[3] describing a late game that swings to Jayce. That is escalated rather than guessed — see questionsForUser. Kit-flag misfire: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) is tagged 'dash' but Riot's text gives it no movement; Disdain is his only mobility. Also removed: three references to Echoing Flames granting shields, which no text supports.
